citation.title: Criterion for long sustained highly peaked ion temperature in diverted configuration of KSTAR tokamak
citation.authors: H. Han, J. Chung, Y. M. Jeon, J. Kang, Y. S. Na, W. H. Ko, J. W. Juhn, J. Jeong, H. S. Kim, J. Jang, S. H. Hahn, J. K. Lee, Y. H. Lee, S. J. Park, W. C. Kim, S. W. Yoon

topic: Empirical operating recipe for KSTAR FIRE mode. It sustains high, peaked ion temperature in a diverted configuration by avoiding the H-mode transition.
own_question: Which operational parameters govern access to the FIRE mode while avoiding the H-mode transition? The parameters examined are density, NBI power and energy mix, USN versus LSN shape, and BT.
actual_method_and_evidence: Experimental shot comparisons and a density-versus-NBI-power regime classification. Includes a table of access rates by beam-voltage combination with few trials per row, and a regression formula for absorbed beam power. CES appears only as a monitoring diagnostic. There is no estimator, no nowcasting and no pedestal-top analysis. Figures were not visually checked.

claim_checks.allowed_intro_or_theory_claim: KSTAR diverted FIRE-mode operation relies on low density and the USN shape to avoid the H-mode transition. This yields long-sustained, highly peaked core ion temperature monitored with CES.
claim_checks.qualification: This is an empirical recipe based on limited data; the threshold line is only indicative. It concerns core temperature, not the pedestal-top chord.

input_target_timing_if_relevant: Not relevant. The paper gives no CES cadence and no report timing.
forbidden_inferences: Do not cite it as support for nowcasting, or for BES/ECEI information content.
Do not imply that FIRE-mode discharges are in our dataset.
Do not treat fast-ion mechanism statements as demonstrated physics.
Do not equate carbon CES with main-ion Ti.
Do not cite the reference-list DOIs as this paper's DOI.
reason_to_include_or_exclude: It provides only optional KSTAR context on ion-temperature operating regimes. It does not address our estimation question, so exclude it unless general context about the KSTAR campaign is needed.
source_scope_note: All extracted page texts supplied; figure/equation visual validation remains separate
